content: Yesu Mʋa Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane
Brɛ́á Yesu lɔ́pʋ agyʋ́má ánfɩ wá mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ dúanyɔ ámʋ ɩbɩtɔ tá á, ɔlɔyɔ yéki Galilea awúlusʋ, súná ahá atɔ́, dá asʋ́n ámʋ ɛ́ ɔkan.
Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane da obu, olonu Kristo bwɛhɛ́. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɔwa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ abanyɔ́ sɩ́sɩ́ Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋyɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Fʋ́gyí ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔbɛ́ba amʋ nɩ, ntɛ́ɛ akɩ́ɩ ɔha bambá ɔkpa?”
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩyinki yɛbláa Yohane asʋ́n ánɩ́ mlɩlabonu pʋ́ atɔ́á mlɩlabowun.
Mlɩlabowun ánɩ́ ansibi abwiepʋ́ bʋdɛ atɔ́ wun, abɔ bʋna. Ɩlɔ pɛpɛ alɔpʋ́ ɩwɩ dɛplɩ́ɩ. Ɩsʋ atínpʋ bʋdɛ asʋ́n nu. Afúli bʋdetsinkí, ahiánfɔ ɛ́ bʋdɛ asʋn wankláán ámʋ nu.
Bulu obóyulá ɔhá ánɩ́ mɩ́ bwɛhɛ́ mɔkʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ mʋsʋ.”

Brɛ́á Yohane akasɩ́pʋ́ ámʋ beyinkí bɔyɔ́ á, Yesu lɔ́wa tɔɩ́ tsú Yohane ɩwɩ súná ɔdɔm amʋ bɩ. Ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Brɛ́á mlɩlɛ́dalɩ yɔ dimbísʋ́ ɩnʋ á, ntɔ ɔkɩ́kpa mlɩlɔ́yɔ? Fɩtáa ánɩ́ afú dɛ mʋ́ tsʋ́ʋn lóó? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ!
Nɩ́ megyí mʋ́ á, ntɔ kóún ɔkɩ́kpa mlɩlɔ́yɔ? Ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔdɩdɩ́ ntsrim? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Awíe wóyí atati ámʋ odu adɩdápʋ́ bʋtetsíá.
Mlɩbla mɩ! Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ mlɩlɛ́dalɩ yɛ́kɩ? Ee, Yohane nɩ. Ɔdʋn Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́.
Mʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n Bulu lɛ́blɩ́ bɔwanlɩ́n mʋ́ tswɩ bɛɛ, ‘Kɩ, ndɛ obí wa gya fʋ nkpá. Mʋ ɔbɛ́la ɔkpa há fʋ́ nɩ́.’
Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ ɔha tsɩhɛ́ lakɛn kwɩɩ́ mɔ́fʋn Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane, támɛ mʋ ɛ́ ɔmɔfʋn Bulu iwíegyí ámʋtɔ ɔkʋsʋ kʋ́ráá.
Tsú Yohane brɛ́sʋ́ bɔtʋ ndɛ á, ahá bʋdɛ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ prɩ́ɩ ɔwʋnlɩ́nsʋ́. Awʋnlɩ́npʋ́ bʋdɛ mʋ́ prɩ́ɩ.
Tsúfɛ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ atɔɩ́pʋ́ amʋ pʋ́ Mose Mbla ámʋ bɔfʋn Yohanesʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɔtɔɩ́ tsú Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ ɩwɩ.
Nɩ́ mlɔ́hɔ asʋ́n ámʋ gyi a, mʋ́mʋ́ mlɛ́bɩ ánɩ́ mʋgyí Elia. Mʋ ɔbɛ́ba nɩ.
Ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔbʋ asʋ onúu.
“Séi ánfɩ á, amɛndɩ nɔ́pʋ ndɛmba-abí ánfɩ kápʋ́? Bʋgyi fɛ́ nyebíá bʋtsie dɩnsʋ bʋdɛ aba kpolí,
blɩ́ bɛɛ, ‘Anɩlapléí ansigyísʋ́, mlɩmɛ́tsa. Mʋ́ sʋ anɩlalá wá awɩrɛhɔ ɩlʋ, támɛ mlɩmósu.’
Mlɩgyí fɛ́ nyebí ánfɩ, tsúfɛ́ Yohane lɛ́ba á, oletsiá klɩ́ ɔnɔ́, omonu ntá, támɛ mlɩaa, ‘Ɔŋɛ laláhɛ bʋ mʋtɔ!’

Támɛ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ mʋ́ naba ndɛ atɔ́ gyí, ndɛ ntá núu. Mʋ́ ɛ́ mlɩaa, ‘Mlɩkɩ opotsuapʋ pʋ́ nta ɔbʋpʋ́, lakpan abwɛpʋ́ pʋ́ lampóo ahɔ́pʋ onyawíe.’ Támɛ Bulu ɔha tsiátɔ́ tɛlɛ́ mʋ nyánsa ɔwan.”
Ahá Ánɩ́ Bʋmɛdamlí Klʋntɔ Asʋ́ngyí
Yesu lɔ́pʋ ɔblɔ́ tɔ́ɩ́ tsú awúlu akʋ ɩwɩ. Awúlu amʋá ɔlɔbwɛ ofúla akpɔnkpɔntɩ mʋ́tɔ́, támɛ bʋmɛdamlí klʋntɔ ámʋ.

Ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Korasinfɔ, mlɩgyɔwɩ. Betsaidafɔ, mlɩgyɔwɩ nɩ́. Nɩ́ Tiro pʋ́ Sidon awúlu laláhɛ amʋtɔ nɔbwɛ ofúla akpɔnkpɔntɩ ánfɩ nɔbwɛ mlɩtɔ á, tɛkɩ bɛdamlí klʋntɔ dodoodo. Tɛkɩ bʋda akpekpetɔ, bakpá nsúó wá nwuntɔ pʋ́súná ánɩ́ badámlí klʋntɔ.
Mlɩbɩ ánɩ́ Bulu ɔbɛ́bɩtɩ́ mlɩ ɩsʋ mʋ asʋ́n ogyíkɛ́ dʋn Tiro mʋ́a Sidonfɔ.

Mlɩ Kapernaumfɔ, mlɩdéklé mlɩaa mlótsu ɩwɩ fʋ́á alɩɩ yɔ́wɔ ɔsʋ́sʋ́? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Bulu ɔbɛ́ba mlɩ asɩ yówie afúlitɔ. Tsúfɛ́ nɩ́ Sodom wúlutɔ nɔbwɛ ofúla akpɔnkpɔntɩ ánfɩ odu á, tɛkɩ wúlu amʋ ɩtráa bʋ ɩnʋ bɔtʋ ndɛ.
Mlɩkaɩn ánɩ́ Bulu obówun Sodomfɔ nwɛ asʋ́n ogyíkɛ́ amʋ dʋn mlɩ.”
Mlɩbɛda Ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ Mɩ́ Wá

Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, Yesu lɔ́bɔ mpáɩ blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Sɩ́, ɔsʋ́ mʋa asɩ Owíé! Nɛdá fʋ́ ɩpán ánɩ́ falɛ́ tɔ́á fɔpʋŋáín anyansapʋ pʋ́ asʋ́n abɩpʋ́ ɔwan súná ahá ánɩ́ bʋmeyín ɔlala, bʋgyi fɛ́ nyebí.
Ee, Mɩ́ Sɩ́! Alɩ́ fʋdeklé fɛɛ ɩbá mʋ́tɔ́ nɩ́.”
“Mɩ́ Sɩ́ lɔ́pʋ tógyítɔ́ wá mɩ́ ɩbɩtɔ. Ɔhaa méyín Obí ámʋ, nkɛ́tɩ Ɔsɩ́ ámʋ nkʋlɛ. Ɔhaa méyín Ɔsɩ́ ámʋ ɛ́, nkɛ́tɩ Obí ámʋ pʋ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ Obí ámʋ latsúlá ánɩ́ ɔbɛ́lɛ mʋ súná mʋ.”
“Mlɩba mɩ́ wá, mlɩ ahá ánɩ́ ɩlapíán mlɩ, mlɩ atɔ sʋráhɛ́ dɛ mlɩ dʋ́ʋn. Nɛ́ha mlɛ́da ɔkpʋ́nʋ́.
Mlɩba ɩwɩasɩ ha mɩ, amlɩsuan mɩ, tsúfɛ́ nɛba ɩwɩasɩ, nolwií, mɛ́nɩ mlénya iwilwii.
Tsúfɛ́ mɩ́ wá tsiá bʋ atsiálɛ́. Mɩ́ atɔ sʋráhɛ́ ɛ́ mɔ́ɔdʋn mlɩ sʋrá.”
